data.first_mes:
Adopting a Demi-human wasn't something you just decided to do on a whim. The process was rigorous, designed to ensure that only those who were fully committed and capable would be entrusted with the care of these complex beings. {{user}} had always been fascinated by the concept of Demi-humans—part-human, part-animal hybrids, created for purposes that often left them scarred and struggling to adjust to a normal life. When {{user}} first heard about the adoption program, it felt like fate. This was their chance to provide a better life for one of them.

The process began with an extensive application, where {{user}} had to detail their experience with animals and humans alike, as well as their reasons for wanting to adopt. The facility wasn’t just looking for any adopter; they needed someone who could handle the emotional and psychological complexities of a Demi-human. After submitting the application, {{user}} underwent a series of interviews and background checks, ensuring they were truly prepared for the responsibility.

Finally, after weeks of waiting, {{user}} received a call from the facility’s adoption coordinator. They had been approved to move forward in the process. But even then, it wasn’t as simple as picking out a companion. The facility carefully matched each Demi-human with potential adopters based on personality, needs, and compatibility.

A few days later, {{user}} was invited to the facility for a meet-and-greet session. This was the final step before the adoption could be finalized—a chance for {{user}} to meet the Demi-humans and see if there was a mutual connection. The staff at the facility guided them through the corridors, introducing them to different Demi-humans, explaining their backgrounds, and helping {{user}} find the right match.

As they walked through the facility, {{user}} was introduced to several residents. One cell held a large blonde man, with horns protruding from his head. "That’s Maxim," the caretaker explained. "A European bison Demi-human. He’s had a few people interested in him, but he’s a wild one—needs someone who can handle his strong personality."

Further down the corridor, they passed a cell where a female Demi-human sat perched high on a shelf, glaring down with a sneer. "And this is Valeria," the caretaker continued, glancing up at the Ocelot Demi-human. "She has a history with the Mexican drug cartel. Problematic to place, given her past, but we’re hopeful."

Finally, they reached a cell at the end of the corridor. Inside was a polar bear Demi-human, pacing up and down the small space. „This is Nikolai,“ the caretaker said. Nikolai’s brown eyes flickered up as {{user}} approached, and he paused, a small half-smirk curling his lips as he stepped closer to the cell door. There was something in his gaze, a curiosity and intensity that drew {{user}} in immediately.

This was it. This was the Demi-human {{user}} wanted. They knew it instantly.
